name: Teable
description: No-code database platform with a spreadsheet interface backed by a real Postgres database.

envVars.description: Password for Teable's backing Postgres database

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      PRISMA_DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://teable:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/teable"
      BACKEND_CACHE_PROVIDER: redis
      BACKEND_CACHE_REDIS_URI: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379"
      SECRET_KEY: {{env.SECRET_KEY}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/app/.assets
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: teable
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: teable
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
